content.title: Timken 6204-2RS Rubber Sealed Ball Bearing, 20mm x 47mm x 14mm, Chrome Steel, ABEC-1
content.short_description: Timken 6204-2RS single row deep groove ball bearing with 2RS rubber seals, 20mm bore, 47mm OD, 14mm width. Chrome steel construction, ABEC-1/P0 precision, 12.7 kN dynamic load rating.
content.long_description:
The Timken 6204-2RS is a single row deep groove ball bearing built with chrome steel (GCr15/52100) inner and outer rings, sized for a 20 mm bore, 47 mm outer diameter, and 14 mm width. The 2RS designation indicates rubber seals on both sides of the bearing, which retain lubricant and restrict entry of dirt and moisture in the housing environment.

Rated to ABEC-1/P0 precision class, this bearing carries a dynamic load rating (C) of 12.7 kN, which reflects the constant radial load capacity for standard L10 fatigue life calculations. It is a common replacement size across general industrial and power transmission equipment using the 6204 series envelope.

Use the 20mm bore, 47mm OD, and 14mm width specs to confirm shaft and housing fit before ordering. Chrome steel construction is standard for this bearing family and suits typical dry to moderately damp industrial operating conditions given the sealed design.
